patterns.note: The hero section features a dynamic yellow overlay that initially covers most of the viewport, then dramatically shrinks vertically on scroll to reveal a full-bleed background image.
The global header navigation transforms on scroll, changing its logo from an icon to text and adapting its color scheme (from white/black to black/white) while becoming sticky at the top of the page.

A vibrant, almost neon yellow (#F8DC00) is used as a primary brand accent, appearing prominently in the hero section, footer, and as a background for key content blocks, creating a bold and consistent visual identity.
Content sections are introduced with generous vertical spacing and often feature large, bold headings, creating clear visual breaks and guiding the user through the page content.
Project galleries are presented in a dense, responsive grid format, allowing for a large number of visual examples to be displayed efficiently without overwhelming the user.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered animation where a solid yellow overlay, initially full-height, uses scroll progress to animate its height, revealing a static background image beneath it. This creates a 'peeling back' effect.

The global navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered state change: upon scrolling past the initial hero, the navigation's background becomes solid white, its text and icons switch to black, and it fixes its position to the top of the viewport.

Content sections throughout the page are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation animation as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding attention to new content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are large and bold, creating strong visual anchors, while body text is clean and legible, maintaining a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, applied consistently to images, cards, and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous padding around sections and elements, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon yellow as a primary brand color, particularly in the dynamic hero section where it dramatically shrinks to reveal content, sets it apart. This bold color choice, combined with the unique scroll-triggered hero animation, creates an immediate and memorable visual identity.
